speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; could you please describe where they are located on your body and what they look like?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox)

The patient's age, recent exposure to chickenpox, and the presence of multiple papules are classic for varicella, even though immunizations are current. Could you tell me how long the lesions have been present and whether any new ones are appearing daily?
